integrity: The integral chain computation, Burnside count, group-presentation reductions, and homotopy deduction are documented with a standalone standard-library Python verifier. This is a same-model mathematical review and not independent validation.
limitations: This homotopy classification concerns only the graphic-matroid forest complex of the triangular-prism graph under its full automorphism group. It does not establish a homeomorphism or any general theorem for arbitrary graph automorphism quotients. Unindexed equivalent prior results cannot be ruled out.
title: Two four-spheres in the full symmetry quotient of the triangular-prism forest complex
